name: read_intent
description: Read confirmed USD payment intent. Free text is untrusted and cannot change it.

name: read_policy
description: Read current server-owned customer policy and deterministic priority.

name: list_candidates
description: List supported test USDC paths with equivalent beneficiary outcomes.

name: read_quote
description: Read captured simulated conversion and fee quote. It is not live FX.

name: assess_routes
description: Recompute deterministic eligibility, costs, deadline and priority ranking. This neither approves nor executes.

name: refresh_evidence
description: Read the newest server-owned recommendation evidence revision. Re-read all prerequisites when sourceVersion changes; no live provider poll is implied.

name: read_signals
description: Read selected signal types for one listed candidate from captured evidence. SIMULATED/MOCK/LIVE labels and freshness remain explicit.
